name: Keep living NSCLC patients (Interim)
remarks: Keeps only patients with an active non-small cell lung cancer diagnosis, matching the demo study population (EMPOWER-Lung 1, NCT03088540).

Provenance: Synthea 'keep module' (generic module framework v2), passed to synthea-with-dependencies.jar with -k. Written by the Interim team on 2026-10-10; copied verbatim from the module used for the committed run, with this remarks line added. Codes are the SNOMED CT concepts Synthea's lung_cancer module assigns to NSCLC (unstaged and TNM stage 1-4). Used by scripts/synthea/run_synthea.py; the importer (scripts/synthea/import_synthea.py) reads the same codes from data/synthetic/synthea/import_tables.json and a test keeps the two lists equal.
